::: {.cv-profile}
Materials and mechanics engineer with a PhD in Mechanical and Mechatronics Engineering from the University of Waterloo. I derive thermodynamically consistent constitutive models, implement them at solver level as Fortran user-material subroutines, design the experiments needed to challenge them, and validate predictions from microstructure through coupon and component response.
:::

::: {.cv-highlights}
::: {.cv-highlight}
**Current focus**
Constitutive modeling for automotive forming, crash, and steel failure
:::
::: {.cv-highlight}
**Methods**
Finite deformation, crystal plasticity, damage, EBSD, DIC, IR
:::
::: {.cv-highlight}
**Implementation**
Fortran UMAT/VUMAT, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Python, PyTorch
:::
:::

## Research Experience

::: {.timeline}
::: {.timeline-entry}
**Doctoral Research Assistant**
University of Waterloo | Jan 2022 - Aug 2026

Developed a thermodynamically consistent damage evolution model and implemented it into a rate-dependent crystal-plasticity framework using Fortran. Investigated void nucleation, damage growth, temperature rise, texture evolution, and high-strain-rate failure in HSLA, DP, and Q&P steels. Conducted experimental validation using tensile testing, EBSD, DIC, and IR thermography.

Industry-sponsored doctoral program with General Motors, connecting constitutive-model development and multiscale validation to practical automotive R&D requirements.
:::

::: {.timeline-entry}
**Master Thesis Researcher**
Fraunhofer UMSICHT, Oberhausen | Jul 2020 - Apr 2021

Modeled borehole heat exchangers with phase-change materials as backfill. Built and validated transient ANSYS/Fluent models for coaxial, U-tube, and spiral heat exchanger designs and studied thermal conductivity, latent heat, and phase transition temperature effects.
:::

::: {.timeline-entry}
**Research Assistant**
Fraunhofer IWS, Dresden | Jul 2020 - Mar 2021

Worked on shielding-nozzle design for the COAXshield laser metal deposition system using ANSYS CFX, CAD-FEA integration, and parametric flow/thermal optimization.
:::

::: {.timeline-entry}
**Research Intern**
German Aerospace Centre (DLR), Augsburg | Sep 2019 - Dec 2019

Performed thermal-structural simulations for automated fibre placement and validated thermal-gradient predictions against experimental measurements.
:::

::: {.timeline-entry}
**Research Project Assistant**
Technische Universitat Chemnitz | Apr 2019 - Aug 2019

Developed RVE-based FE models for fibre-reinforced plastics with nonlinear elastic matrix behavior and generated effective material-property maps.
:::
:::
